controller.gradient_cosine_definition: unweighted network-gradient cosine between PDE residual and RK4 defect

descriptive_interpretation: The PDE and RK4 network gradients were usually strongly aligned, while the controller kept their weighted gradient magnitudes close to parity. The physics budget stayed close to an equal residual/RK4 allocation; in blocks 2--4, most of the constraint budget shifted from the boundary term to replay.
diagnostic_scope: completed grouped_rate1 runs from the locked confirmatory campaign
qualification: Adaptive updates within a seed are serially dependent. Pooled update summaries describe controller operation and are not inferential replicate-level evidence.
study: Allen--Cahn ten-seed grouped adaptive RK4 controller mechanism
